# Attribution, rights, and coverage

**Project:** The reciprocal effect of value and arousal on conscious awareness in binocular rivalry task.

**Authors credited in the source README:** Tom Salomon, Yael Solar Priel, Yarden Shir, Keren Shoval, Rinat Kiperman, Liad Mudrik, and Tom Schonberg.

**Upstream:** https://github.com/tomsalomon/BinocularRivalry/tree/fb86674524005027e8e9eb77b66f695d1df6d25f

**Pinned commit:** `fb86674524005027e8e9eb77b66f695d1df6d25f`.

**License:** MIT; Copyright (c) 2018 Tom Salomon. The complete unmodified [LICENSE](LICENSE), including warranty disclaimer, is retained. The upstream README also explicitly permits data/script reuse and requests academic credit. This archive implies no endorsement by the creators. No third-party stimulus images are included or relicensed.

Five upstream files are copied without byte modification; their local locations differ from upstream directory locations, as documented in [provenance.json](provenance.json). The archive comprises README, LICENSE, the merger script, one trial workbook and its same-directory parameter workbook. Source-relative links and full-dataset paths need not resolve in this intentionally partial snapshot.

The workbook contains a pseudonymously filed behavioral event record and intended stimulus configuration, not a newly collected participant dataset. No demographic/ratings records or stimulus images were downloaded. Consent, recruitment, executed task configuration, clock accuracy, and participant validity were not independently audited. The bounded use is event/reference inspection only, without reidentification, population inference, or publication-results reproduction.

The attribution file, provenance metadata, and [local report](../../../REPORTED_CONTENT_REFERENCE_CASE.md) are local additions, not upstream text.
